widget.ok: GDrive Sync: {n} folders synced, last run {ago}

folders.pick_title: Folder to sync with Google Drive
folders.offline_placeholder: Drive folder to keep offline, e.g. Documents/Work
folders.offline_missing: Type the path of a folder on Drive first
folders.hint: In Dolphin, right-click a folder → Google Drive Sync, or right-click a folder under rclone:/ → Keep offline. Offline copies go to ~/Drive Offline.
folders.empty: No synced folders yet. Add one above.
folders.stop: Stop syncing (files stay on both sides)

trash.hint: Files a sync removed are kept here for {days} days. Restore puts a file back in its folder; the next sync copies it to the other side again.

settings.root: Folder on Drive for this computer's folders
settings.applies_to_new: Applies to folders you add from now on. Folders already syncing keep their place on Drive.
settings.resync_hint: Rebuilds the sync state. Merges both sides and never deletes.
settings.uninstall_hint: Uninstall removes the timer, the Dolphin menus and ~/.local/bin/gdrive-sync. Your settings, folder list and files are kept.

setup.intro: A few things are needed before folders can sync.
setup.no_accounts: No Google Drive account in rclone yet. Add one with rclone config: choose "n" (new remote), give it a name such as gdrive, pick "drive" and sign in in the browser. Then press Check again.
setup.install_hint: Puts gdrive-sync in ~/.local/bin, adds the Dolphin right-click menus and starts the sync timer.
